scope: The surviving earth-and-mudbrick Farah Bala Hisar wall circuit and bastions in the 2004 photographed era, with the southern gate opening and the documented pale portico and ruined wing.

references.filename: American Soldiers outside the Citadel of Alexander the Great in Farahs, Afghanistan 2004.jpg

originalReview.notes: Full original wide view. The damaged wing, regular portico bays, curved corner, high parapet and eroded pale mound appear behind the group.
Close original upward view. The square molded piers, broad lintel, recessed parapet panels and surviving decorative soffit are visible.

quallaSearch.notes: Two exact native September 15 originals match the creator’s first-party CC0 declarations on upload and today. The third local candidate is a derivative of the wide photograph with an inconsistent caption date. Its native original provides the same view.
